description: The frontend's Context & Session surface: what it may render about a session, a context window, a rollover and a continuation, and what it must never become. Context & Session is ONE LEGO with TWO contracts (ai.context = what is loaded now, ai.agent-session = bounded state: identity plus references). The catalog ships EMPTY on purpose: this is a state surface, so it renders what it is handed and names every absence. Conversation, session, context window, memory and execution stay five distinct things; no generic AI-state object is derived from them.

rows.notes: P2.13 smallest additive publication from the already-declared ai.context fields and Context & Session operation vocabulary. The implementation is bounded local state only: no model/provider/runtime dependency, no transcript dump, no Memory store. Contract lock publication does not make P2.13 complete; Manager reconciliation, merge validation and post-merge verification remain required.

P2.13 smallest additive publication from the established ai.agent-session fields and states. A session is bounded identity/control state with references, never an unbounded transcript. The implementation remains provider/runtime-neutral.

publication.note: Published on protected main at efa3da35 via PR #45 (merged by manager). Both ai.context@1.0.0 and ai.agent-session@1.0.0 are locked with status implemented, 5 context operations, 3 session operations, and 5 permissions. The frontend quotes that publication and derives published.

rules: Conversation != Session != Context window != Memory != Execution. The five stay distinct in the UI, and a record that merges them is refused (assertDistinctConcepts).

Every shared word is quoted from the backend declaration with provenance: 7 scopes, 9 context fields, 6 context lifecycle states, 14 continuation sections, 5 declared verbs, 2 registered context operations, 3 session operations, 7 session states, 10 session fields, 3 references, 5 permissions, 3 token kinds. Nothing is coined here.

The rollover phase machine (NORMAL -> PREPARE -> ROLLOVER) and the verification results (verified / degraded / failed) were promoted into VOCABULARIES upon publication of ai.context@1.0.0 on protected main (commit efa3da35, PR #45).
A usage figure is reported, estimated, not-reported or over-budget, and carries its token kind or is not rendered. No percentage is computed from nothing and no estimate is presented as a report.
A rollover threshold must be declared and strictly below the bound: a threshold at or above 100% is refused, because a rollover at the limit has no room left to write the continuation package.

Verification is explicit and has three results. Missing state is reported as missing and is never silently repaired; a degraded continuation is announced and a failed one is never rendered as a new session.
State carries references, never payloads: a session holds contextRef, artifactRef and traceRef, and an inlined transcript, message list or context body is refused as unbounded.

No credentials, tokens, secrets, cookies, authorization headers, chain-of-thought, raw or hidden prompts, transcripts, full model output, host paths or capability grants - refused by name and by key pattern.

The published operations are exactly five (ai.context.load, ai.context.compact, ai.agent-session.create, ai.agent-session.status, ai.agent-session.close) and the UI offers none of them; `Continue session` is an intent answered operation-unpublished.
No Memory store is implied: what may be counted is loaded context, decisions and artifacts, and the surface says that is what they are (XA-12).
No execution affordance: the Agent Machine has no runtime, and this surface is not it.
Records are supplied to the runtime by the application; this package never reads the backend tree, and nothing it returns enters the 18,126-byte boot descriptor.

A declaration that moved past the quoted vocabulary is reported (declarationDrift) and never adopted silently; a version claimed in a file is reported as declaredVersion and is still not a publication.

alignment.rule: A difference between this package's quoted vocabulary and the declaration it consumes is reported as data (declarationDrift) and registered, never resolved by adopting a word this package cannot quote. There is no tolerated difference: REGISTERED_DRIFT in test/29 is empty, so a backend that spells a scope, a state, a section or an operation differently fails the gate until the manager reconciles it.
relatedDecisions: XA-12 (memory is not context; no store may be implied)
XA-17 (which contract publishes token usage; the three token kinds are quoted with a pending record)
XA-11 (where Skill is modelled - unaffected: P2.13 adds no domain)
